title: GPT-6.2 Astra Identifies Creator of 1808 Yale Sketchbook
summary: History professor Mark Humphries reports that GPT-6.2 Astra, given minimal prompting, autonomously identified the creator of an anonymous 1808 sketchbook held at Yale’s Beinecke Library in 22 minutes using public primary and secondary sources. According to the account, the model found a diary reference to a visit by the vicomte de Chabot five days before a date in the sketchbook and predicted that Chabot’s travel journal, available only by order from Cleveland State University, would confirm the attribution. Humphries says the journal did confirm it and is itself a significant find for Canadian and fur-trade historians; the short write-up does not detail the prompts, search steps, or verification method.
